d: Very long, flowing midnight blue hair with straight bangs and a single small ahoge curl. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a white and black high-collar jacket with red accents, a short black pleated skirt featuring a red waist panel with a white "OZ" logo, and heavy red and black mechanical armored boots that extend up to the mid-thigh.
